cards.heading: Thinking Systems: runtime control and differentiation
cards.byline: Public response by Arkadiy Dobkin · EPAM founder
cards.text:
Thinking Systems: runtime control and differentiation

Public response by Arkadiy Dobkin · EPAM founder

In a public LinkedIn post about Thinking Systems, Dobkin recommended the article to readers building systems where model judgment has consequential effects. He emphasized runtime control and outlined two possibilities: model-mediated software could address problems previously impractical to automate, while domain- and client-specific control architectures could remain differentiating as models and generic infrastructure commoditize.

Read the original post ↗
Formulation provenance

The published article separately credits an earlier exchange with Dobkin for helping shape the Thinking Systems formulation.

Read the formulation provenance ↗
